operator_direction: Replace only the installed Console OS OTA-0 application with the verified successor that restores legacy P4CART catalog compatibility while preserving native P4G games and the current Console OS features.

ota_data.live_policy: mutable boot-selection state; preserve without writing or requiring the initial digest

predecessor.boot_progress: reached P4_CONSOLE_OS READY with positive main-stack low-water telemetry, a valid embedded Byte Buddy P4G package, and repeated stable runtime reports
predecessor.observed_limitation: native P4G packages were cataloged, but the legacy P4CART1 validator and catalog path were no longer connected to Console OS

candidate.correction: Restore the bounded, read-only P4CART1 validator as an isolated PSRAM-backed background catalog scan; expose validated carts in Game Manager without passing them to the native P4G loader; retain P4G execution and all newer Console OS features.

legacy_p4cart_seed.runtime_policy: catalog and display only; sandboxed Lua execution remains a separate unimplemented milestone

acceptance_required_after_install: native catalog reports embedded_default=1 and at least one valid P4G package
P4CART scan begins only after Console OS storage and launcher initialization
P4CART scan completes with bounded candidate, valid, and rejected counts and reports runtime=lua-pending writes=0
boot reaches P4_CONSOLE_OS READY without panic or reset
launcher remains alive for at least two periodic runtime reports with the P4CART scan idle and stable counts
no SD format or write occurs during installation or catalog validation
